desc: The ProTac 2.0 produces 2,000 lumens without sacrificing run time. Features TEN-TAP programming; choice of three user selectable programs: high/strobe/low , high only and low/medium/high; strobe for signaling or disorienting; IP67 rated; dust-tight and waterproof to 2 meters, 2 meter impact resistance tested; Anti-roll head prevents the light from rolling away when placed on a flat surface. Powered by the SL-B50 battery pack that charges inside or outside of the light using a USB-C cord. Includes USB-C cord, removable pocket clip and nylon holster.
